description: Search SBPivot (the SBGrid3.0 PIVOT grid, created with SBPivot.createPivot) API and option documentation by keyword. Use for pivot/cross-tab requirements: data summarized by row fields x column fields with aggregated values (sum/count/avg), subtotals and grand totals, field drag settings, drill-through, expand/collapse. Start here, then call getSBPivotAPIDetail or getSBPivotExample. For a regular list/edit grid use searchSBGridAPI instead. [Pivot grid only — SBPivot.createPivot. Decide first which grid the user needs; if it is unclear whether they want a regular grid or a pivot grid, ask the user.] ⚠️ SBPivot 코드/샘플 생성 시 서버 공통지침(요청 범위의 제품 기능 우선 · 'Using Pivot' 문서의 구성(dataSource + pivot)에서 출발 · pivotConfig 리터럴 명시 · 불필요한 기능 추가 금지) 준수 — 상세는 서버 instructions 참고.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default 5.

query.description: Keyword to search (e.g. 'fields', '소계', 'grandTotal', 'drillThrough', '집계 함수', '펼침'). The word 'pivot/피벗' itself is not needed.

name: searchSBPivotAPI
